summary: Stage 1 found a blocker: the shared contained reader correctly enforces identity, regular-file, byte-limit, and platform guarantees, but the SAC wrapper calls the lower-level descriptor reader without the required regular-file and maximum-byte policy. Stage 2 was blocked by the failed specification gate.
summary_markdown: See T23-review.md for the Stage 1 matrix, F-001, bounded evidence, interrupted-attempt disclosure, and Stage 2 gate decision.

acceptance.criterion: Internal symlink chains read the same bytes within a narrow owner root; external/replaced owner/target paths are refused without disclosure.
acceptance.evidence: The shared reader pins root and target identities; 17 focused containment tests pass and the existing T17 probe returns CONTAINED_READ_RACE.

acceptance.criterion: Descriptor/platform/file-type/size guarantees hold for the supported runtime and fail explicitly otherwise; SAC nofollow is not weakened.
acceptance.evidence: The shared reader and descriptor seam implement the guarantees, but src/sac/secure-resource-read.ts:15 supplies neither maxBytes nor requireRegularFile; a bounded 8 MiB+1 fixture was accepted.

acceptance.criterion: Stage 1 then Stage 2 independent verdict with concrete evidence and no own-code review.
acceptance.evidence: Stage 1 was completed independently and failed on F-001; Stage 2 was explicitly blocked by the local review workflow. Own output-validator and health code were excluded.

artifacts.summary: T23 containment/SAC Stage 1 review and blocker finding

findings.problem: The SAC secure reader invokes readDescriptorChain without maxBytes or requireRegularFile, so SAC inputs bypass the approved file-type and size policy.
findings.impact: Repository-controlled SAC evidence/resource inputs can be read beyond the shared 8 MiB bound, and non-regular inputs reach a potentially blocking final open instead of being refused by policy.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass an explicit approved maxBytes value and requireRegularFile: true from readWorkspaceFileNoFollow, then add direct SAC-wrapper regressions for over-limit and non-regular inputs while retaining O_NOFOLLOW and fail-closed platform behavior.
findings.evidence: src/sac/secure-resource-read.ts:15; src/lib/descriptor-read.ts:89-95 and :140-159; bounded fixture result in .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T12-40-02-860Z_run.log.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Inspected the complete SAC wrapper and every descriptor option/enforcement path for file type, byte count, and platform capability.
